annotations.text:
(Recommended) Hero D · axis: framed portrait.
Why: it is Hero B's copy column (H1, lead, both CTAs, four credentials, availability pill, all lifted) with the four-tile mosaic replaced by the live homepage hero photo in the for-sale .chero frame (22px radius, 1280/960, same shadow), so it is the one hero of the three whose every element already ships somewhere on the site. Measured at 1440 the #hero-grid is 385.8px (range 350 to 400), and its Mobile root is 862px, the shortest of the round with F at 863px and E at 1071px. One image above the fold means the LCP asset is the same single hero-midland.webp the live page already loads; E adds two more requests before the H1 at 390.
Trade-off: the inventory is asserted by the pill, not shown. Evie ($1,500) and Roys ($2,300) leave the hero, and the Desktop ribbon wraps its fourth credential onto a second line because the copy column is the narrower 1.08fr of the .chero split.

Hero E · axis: lead photo + pair.
Why: it is the only one of the three that keeps Hero B's named-bird evidence (Evie, Timneh $1,500; Roys, Congo $2,300, prices per data/price-matrix.json) while still leading with the live hero-midland.webp, so the claim on the pill is backed by two priced birds in the same viewport. Desktop #hero-grid measures 389.5px, inside the 350 to 400 range, with the right column set at 370px so the wide tile (156px) plus two square tiles with captions beneath (233px) fit the band.
Trade-off: it is the tallest Mobile hero at 1071px (209px more than D) because three photos stack above the H1 at 390, and the wide tile is only 156px tall at Desktop, which crops the Midland, Texas sign to a strip.

Hero F · axis: credential band.
Why: it moves the four credentials out of the copy column into a full-width band on #234f3b along the hero's bottom edge, which shortens the copy column to 260px at Desktop and lets the photo run as a 300 x 322 portrait; the #hero-grid measures exactly 380px at 1440 (322 photo + 16 gap + 42 band), the tightest fit of the three. The band gives the credentials one row at Desktop and a 2 x 2 grid at Tablet and Mobile with the same SVG check, and the availability pill sits on the photo so nothing hangs outside the frame. Mobile root is 863px.
Trade-off: at 390 the band lands below both CTAs at about 590px from the top of the hero, so the credentials are the last thing read rather than the line under the H1 that Hero B and the for-sale ribbon put them on, and the 300px-wide photo is the narrowest hero image of the round.
